description: A made-up scenario: planning a movie night, where the day has to fit both sides' week.
title: Plan a movie night
opening_line: Hi! I'm so glad we're planning this movie night together. We need to pick a movie, a snack, and a day. Do you have any ideas?
closing_line: That's our whole movie night planned, then. Thanks for planning this with me, it's going to be so much fun!

participant.brief: You and your friend want to have a movie night. Plan it together.

constraints.text: You're busy on Friday and Saturday evenings.

avatar.brief: You are planning a movie night together with the user, a friend of yours.

constraints.text: You fall asleep during movies longer than two hours.
You have a sore tooth, so nothing hard or crunchy.
You're busy on Monday and Tuesday evenings.
